int main() {
    int w, m;
    std::cin >> w >> m;
    int cur = m;
    bool bad = false;
    for (int i = 1; i <= 100; ++i) {
        int x = cur;
        if (x % w == 0) {
            cur = x / w;
        } else if ((x + 1) % w == 0) {
            cur = (x + 1) / w;
        } else if ((x - 1) % w == 0) {
            cur = (x - 1) / w;
        } else {
            bad = true;
            break;
        }
        if (cur == 0) break;
        if (i == 100 && !(cur == 1 || cur == 0)) {
            bad = true;
            break;
        }
    }
    std::cout << (bad ? "NO" : "YES") << std::endl;
    return 0;
}
